description: Worker w-JSONL-001-0: Implement Structured JSONL Logger Core

tasks.title: Centralize Prompt Cache in Engine
tasks.description: Move prompt file caching into an engine module with documented keys/invalidation and hit/miss logging; keep `buildPrompt` pure.
acceptanceCriteria: Prompt cache reads/writes occur only in `src/engine` and `buildPrompt` no longer manages caching.
Cache keys and invalidation rules are documented in the new module and tests cover hit/miss behavior.
Cache usage is logged with hit/miss metrics and includes `sessionId`, `phase`, and `component`.

tasks.title: Add TUI Rendering Integration Test
tasks.description: Create an integration test that renders TUI views using mocked engine state and verifies render output without invoking business logic.
acceptanceCriteria: Test uses mocked `TuiEngineData`/events and does not execute agents or build prompts.
Render output includes expected labels/sections for the mocked state.

tasks.title: Implement Structured JSONL Logger Core
tasks.description: Update the logging schema to required JSONL fields and implement safe formatting in the logger (service/env defaults, context normalization for request/job IDs and duration, error object enrichment, truncation/circular handling, and structured fallback on write failures). Update session logger initialization and logger unit tests to reflect the new schema.
acceptanceCriteria: Error-level logs always include a structured `error` object with `type` and `message` (and `stack` when available).
Non-serializable or oversized metadata does not throw and is safely stringified/truncated; write failures emit a minimal JSONL line to stderr without crashing.
Session initialization sets a default `request_id` context so all session logs include it.

tasks.title: Add Integration Test for Session JSONL Output
tasks.description: Add an integration test that creates a session, logs a message, and asserts the session log line is valid JSONL with required fields and `request_id` present.
acceptanceCriteria: Test exercises `createSession` + `getLogger` and verifies JSONL output with required fields and `request_id`.
Test passes without relying on console output.
